The '''Crypt of the Ancients''' on [[Necropolis (Core Worlds)|Necropolis]] was the a sacred tomb in a graveyard where the [[Witch/Legends|witch]] [[Sycorax]] and her [[Sycorax's son|son]] were buried. During the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Cornelius Evazan/Legends|Cornelius Evazan]] used the crypt for several his experiments associated with [[Project Starscream]].
